boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named study and gathering spaces documented by UIC Student Centers and the UIC Library.

cards.title: Circle Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, first-floor tower
cards.notes: Take the tower elevator to the first floor and use this named lounge when you need a campus study stop between classes.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Student Center East study lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers lists Circle Lounge on the first floor tower of Student Center East and says it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Montgomery Lounge
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second-floor tower
cards.notes: Use the second-floor tower lounge as a named meeting point or a place to settle into independent work during building hours.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor lounge inside Student Center East.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers locates Montgomery Lounge on the second floor tower of Student Center East and says it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Pier Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor beside Dunkin’
cards.notes: Find this second-floor room beside Dunkin’ when you want a defined study location; microwaves are available for users there.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Student Center East room with microwaves.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers places the Pier Room on Student Center East’s second floor beside Dunkin’ Donuts and notes microwaves are available.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: East Terrace
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor
cards.notes: From the second-floor escalators, turn right toward the Inner Circle and use the terrace entrance on the left for a change of scene.
cards.short_summary: A named terrace study area in Student Center East.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers gives directions to East Terrace on the second floor of Student Center East and says it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: West Terrace
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor
cards.notes: From the second-floor escalators, turn left toward the Inner Circle and use the terrace entrance on the right for study time.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor terrace study area at Student Center East.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers gives directions to West Terrace on the second floor of Student Center East and says it is open during building hours.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Inner Circle
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor behind escalators
cards.notes: Walk behind the second-floor escalators to reach this enclosed named space; use its microwaves if that supports your daytime plan.
cards.short_summary: An Inner Circle study space with microwave access.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers locates Inner Circle on Student Center East’s second floor behind the escalators and notes microwaves are available.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Commuter Center
cards.subtitle: Student Center East, second floor near Circle Burger
cards.notes: Enter the Inner Circle and take the door near Circle Burger to reach the quiet individual-study areas in this named center.
cards.short_summary: A Student Center East space with quiet individual study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Student Centers says the Commuter Center has quiet individual study areas and locates it on Student Center East’s second floor near Circle Burger.
cards.source_title: Study Lounges | Student Centers | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Open during Student Center East building hours; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Circle Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Richard J. Daley Library, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this enclosed first-floor reading room when quiet is the priority, then check the library’s current hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room in Daley Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Library identifies the Circle Reading Room as an enclosed first-floor Daley Library room designated for quiet study.
cards.source_title: Accessibility Services | University Library | University of Illinois Chicago
cards.access_notes: Daley Library is open to the public; check current opening hours before visiting.

cards.title: IDEA Commons
cards.subtitle: Richard J. Daley Library, first floor
cards.notes: Head to the south end of Daley’s first floor for a flexible place to work with research help, technology, group study, or tutoring.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor library commons for technology and collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC describes IDEA Commons as a Daley Library first-floor space with flexible meeting areas, computers, reading areas, classrooms, and a student media lab.
cards.source_title: Library space a great architectural IDEA | UIC Today
cards.access_notes: Located inside Daley Library; check current library opening hours and any room-use guidance.

cards.title: Daley Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Richard J. Daley Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room ahead for a group session, or use an unreserved room until a group with a reservation needs the space.
cards.short_summary: Reservable and walk-in group rooms in Daley Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UIC Library says Daley group study rooms are open for walk-in use, while an online reservation guarantees space for a group.
cards.source_title: Reserve a study room - UIC Library Help Center
cards.access_notes: Reserve online up to five days ahead; walk-in users must yield to groups with reservations.
